definitions.explanation: A person who is put forward or who puts themselves forward for a position, award, or selection. Used in political, professional, and general contexts.

examples.japanese: {候補者|こうほしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{次期|じき}→次期：19838_jiki⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候補者|こうほしゃ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{挙|あ}がった→挙がる：30433_agaru⟧。
examples.english: My name came up as a candidate for the next company president.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五人|ごにん}→五人：30567_gonin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候補者|こうほしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{選挙戦|せんきょせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げた→繰り広げる：06982_kurihirogeru⟧。
examples.english: In the election, five candidates waged a fierce campaign.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧ (candidacy) and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). The base word ⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧ can also be used alone to mean "candidacy" or "candidate" in a broader sense (e.g., candidate locations or candidate items).

USAGE:
{候補者|こうほしゃ} specifically refers to people, while ⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧ can refer to either people or things. In elections, {候補者|こうほしゃ} is the standard term. In business, it covers job candidates, promotion candidates, and award nominees.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {候補者|こうほしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ — to put up a candidate
- {候補者|こうほしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{絞|しぼ}る→絞る：03926_shiboru⟧ — to narrow down the candidates
- ⟦{有力|ゆうりょく}→有力：13007_yuuryoku⟧{候補者|こうほしゃ} — strong/leading candidate
- {候補者|こうほしゃ}{選|えら}び — candidate selection

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧ — candidate, candidacy (broader, includes things as well as people)
- ⟦{志願者|しがんしゃ}→志願者：20919_shigansha⟧ — volunteer, applicant (someone who puts themselves forward)
- ⟦{応募者|おうぼしゃ}→応募者：20440_oubosha⟧ — applicant (someone who applies in response to a call)
